fields.name: InviteId
fields.description: Stable client-visible identifier (separate from IAM's user/itemId so the invite can be referenced before a user record exists).

fields.name: Email
fields.description: Email of the invitee. Marked PII so future storage-encryption policy can target it.

fields.name: RoleSlug
fields.description: Intended role (doctor, nurse, branch_manager, ...). Constrained at the application layer: a branch_manager role may only be created by an admin or clouduser invite, doctor/nurse may be created by branch_manager/quality_lead/admin/clouduser, patient may only be created via public signup (this table is not used for patient signup).

fields.name: OrgId
fields.description: Org the invite targets. For single-org roles (nurse, branch_manager) the user is recorded here; for multi-org roles (doctor) the user may later add more rows in this same table for other orgs.

fields.name: InvitedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user itemId of the inviter (branch_manager / quality_lead / admin / clouduser).

fields.name: ExpiresAt
fields.description: Required for compliance: an invite must expire if not consumed. Default 14 days; cancellable by the inviter until accepted.

fields.name: AcceptedAt
fields.description: When the invitee accepted. Append-only; the acceptance flow also writes a row into OrganizationMember.

fields.name: CancelledAt
fields.description: When the inviter cancelled this invite. Append-only.

fields.name: Note
fields.description: Free-text note from the inviter. Subject to FR-19 firewall scan at write time.
